states.message: Welcome to Gold appraisal and calculations! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.
Purity is checked using a touchstone and nitric acid test, or more accurately with a karat meter (XRF machine) which reads purity without damaging the item.
Net weight = gross weight minus the weight of stones, beads, or non-gold attachments. Only the net gold weight is used for valuation — always deduct, never estimate.
Loan eligibility = today's gold rate per gram × purity % × net weight × 75% LTV cap. Always use the current day's published rate, not yesterday's.
The appraiser must sign the appraisal slip, record gross/net weight and purity, and photograph the pledged items. Never appraise gold without the customer present.
